mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods (name, category_id, category_name, cover, price, stock, sales, description, effect, usage, contraindication, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{categoryName}, #{cover}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{description}, #{effect}, #{usage}, #{contraindication}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE goods SET stock = #{stock}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE goods SET sales = #{sales}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE goods SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM goods WHERE stock <= #{threshold} AND status = 1 ORDER BY stock ASC
